content: 1. Ensure that every page begins with the directive `__NOTOC__` to suppress the table of contents. 2. Verify that there is no separate line for the Associate Editor in Chief on the page. 3. Confirm that titles of multiple editors are separated by semicolons. 4. Remove placeholder statements such as Please help WikiDoc by adding content here. It's easy. Click here to learn about editing. once the content has been added to the page. 5. Ensure that every chapter includes the following three headings: `== Overview ==`, `== Causes ==`, and `== References ==`. 6. Confirm that all headings are properly capitalized. 7. Ensure that no references are placed directly next to the headings. Overview Section 8. Verify that the overview statement is written in text format and does not include bullet points. 9. Confirm that punctuation marks such as periods, commas, and spaces are appropriately placed. 10. Ensure that no text is randomly bolded or italicized within the overview section. 11. Check that there are no floating periods or commas within the text. 12. Confirm that periods and commas are placed before the start of references, rather than at the end, to avoid floating punctuation. 13. Verify that all internal links are functional and that there are no broken or black links within the text. 14. Ensure that no links are created to the same page. For example, avoid linking Ventricular tachycardia to itself. Causes Section 15. Confirm the presence of the following subcategories in the specified order: Life-Threatening Causes Common Causes Causes by Organ System Causes in Alphabetical Order 16. Ensure that the first letter of every word in the subcategory titles is capitalized. 17. Verify that subcategories are formatted under `===` headings. 18. Ensure that no references are placed directly next to subcategory headings. 19. Confirm that each listed cause is a true cause of the symptom and double-check for accuracy if there is any doubt. 20. Verify that all causes are linked to appropriate pages and that proper references are cited. 21. If a cause does not link to a page on WikiDoc but may fall under another page, create an internal link in the recommended format. 22. Ensure that all internal links are functional and that there are no broken or black links within the text. Life-Threatening Causes 23. Confirm the presence of the following definition under the Life-Threatening Causes subheading: Life-threatening causes include conditions which may result in death or permanent disability within 24 hours if left untreated. 24. Ensure that the listed causes do not include chronic conditions. 25. Verify that the causes are listed in alphabetical order. 26. If the disease itself is life-threatening, do not add causes under the Life-Threatening Causes section. Instead, include the following sentence under the subheading: [Disease name] is a life-threatening condition and must be treated as such irrespective of the causes. Life-threatening conditions may result in death or permanent disability within 24 hours if left untreated. Common Causes 27. Under the Common Causes subheading, ensure that the causes are listed in alphabetical order. Causes by Organ System 28. Confirm the presence of a differential diagnosis under the Causes by Organ System subheading. 29. Ensure that the causes listed in each row are separated by a comma followed by a space. 30. Verify that the causes are listed in alphabetical order (e.g., Hodgkin lymphoma and not hodgkin lymphoma). 31. Ensure that each cause is appropriately categorized under the correct organ system. Causes in Alphabetical Order 32. Under the Causes in Alphabetical Order subheading, ensure that the list of causes is arranged in multiple columns.
